mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY r.role_code
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_id

SELECT p.permission_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id
JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY p.permission_code

SELECT DISTINCT m.*, p.permission_code FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = 1
LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_id = m.permission_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_id
